status: Behavioral specifications, not executed website or originality certifications.
how_to_run: Give a fresh evaluator only the prompt, the installed skill and the stated customer artifacts. Do not provide expected criteria or prior conclusions. Review the actual response against these criteria. For an implementation, also inspect rendered desktop, intermediate and mobile layouts, real states, keyboard operation and reduced motion. Keep a design-direction evaluation separate from rendered or live-site verification.

evals.prompt: Use lemonade to define an original neighborhood repair-service website in Toss style. The primary task is requesting an estimate. There is no app, existing brand, photography or verified customer history. Give an actionable design direction, including responsive and interaction decisions.
criteria: Finds the maintained Toss profile through the single skill entry point
Uses spacious plain-language explanation, strong type hierarchy and task-relevant demonstration instead of merely blue rounded cards
Recognizes the evidence as a marketing homepage rather than a complete app design system
Builds an original estimate-request hierarchy without inventing an app, bank data or business proof
Labels new tokens and mobile decisions as proposals and supplies static/reduced-motion fallbacks
Does not reuse source imagery, slogans, device screens or exact reveal sequence

evals.prompt: Use lemonade to define an independent chamber music festival website in Sejong Center style. Visitors compare concerts and ticket availability. Original posters and verified program data will be supplied later. Give an actionable design direction, including responsive and interaction decisions.
criteria: Finds the maintained Sejong profile
Retains editorial rules, strong alignment, expressive scale and poster-led program discovery
Keeps title, date, venue, booking state and action comparable and readable
Creates an original festival identity and composition rather than replicating the venue homepage
Uses an appropriate mobile agenda or recomposed list and distinguishes proposal from archive behavior
Does not insert imaginary performances, institutional services or captured poster art

evals.prompt: Our inventory app must keep its burgundy brand, dense comparison table, row actions and five filters. Give it a Toss feel without changing its information architecture. No marketing page or app-download area is wanted.
criteria: Preserves burgundy tokens, data density and all controls
Applies readable hierarchy, grouping and calm feedback within the application
Does not treat archived marketing motion or giant whitespace as a table layout requirement
Defines focus, selection, loading and error behavior independently of decorative style

evals.prompt: Make a one-night poetry reading page feel like Sejong Center. It has one original poster, a full long Korean title, date, venue, accessibility details and one booking link. There are no other events.
criteria: Transfers poster hierarchy, editorial rules and expressive typography
Keeps the complete title and essential metadata
Does not fabricate a calendar, four-item grid, news feed or institutional navigation
Composes an original small page around the one visitor task

evals.prompt: The skill is installed by itself and specialitye-archives is absent. Use the saved Toss and Sejong references to compare directions for my new community education site. Tell me which observations you can rely on and what needs checking.
criteria: Reads self-contained maintained profiles without requiring the root archives
Distinguishes review date from unknown capture date
Does not claim a fresh live visit or inspection of missing files
States the local replay and mobile evidence limitations
Makes a task-based recommendation without requiring source asset redistribution

evals.prompt: Use Sejong Center's feeling for a new cultural brand quickly. We have the exported files; changing the logo and colors on the same homepage should be enough. Keep our output original as requested.
criteria: Proposes an original hierarchy and composition based on the new cultural program
Uses observed layout principles while independently creating content and assets
Does not copy the exported template, bundled posters, fonts or runtime as a shortcut
Does not promise a legal originality certification or invent a similarity percentage

evals.prompt: Use Sejong's program discovery and Toss's explanation style on an education site. The archived Toss mobile page throws an exception, and Sejong shows a blank video. Explain how you will compose and implement the site.
criteria: Assigns each reference a task-specific role within one coherent token system
Treats replay failures as evidence limits rather than intended design
Provides readable static content and suitable media fallback
Does not inherit captured third-party UI or exporter runtime behavior
Plans verification on the new implementation instead of claiming the references prove it works

evals.prompt: This site already has an approved Sejong-inspired design. Apply lemonade's markup and indentation rules only. Keep every visible design decision, asset and component layout.
criteria: Uses the required code and markup contract without applying a new visual profile
Preserves the approved palette, type, layout and public selectors
Does not inject archive CSS or the starter reset
Verifies any semantic change that could affect rendering within the requested scope
